gloss: company name; name of a company

definitions.gloss: company name; name of a company
definitions.explanation: The official name of a business or corporation.

examples.japanese: {会社名|かいしゃめい}を{入力|にゅうりょく}してください。
{名刺|めいし}には{会社名|かいしゃめい}と{部署名|ぶしょめい}が{記載|きさい}されている。
examples.english: The business card shows the company name and department name.

examples.japanese: {合併|がっぺい}に{伴|ともな}い{会社名|かいしゃめい}が{変更|へんこう}されたため、すべての{書類|しょるい}を{更新|こうしん}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: Since the company name was changed due to a merger, all documents need to be updated.

notes:
Composed of {会社|かいしゃ} (company) and {名|めい} (name). Frequently encountered on forms, business cards, contracts, and official documents. In Japan, formal company names typically include a legal entity suffix such as {株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ} (kabushiki gaisha, often abbreviated K.K.) or {合同会社|ごうどうがいしゃ} (gōdō gaisha, LLC).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会社名|かいしゃめい}を{記入|きにゅう}する — to fill in the company name
- {会社名|かいしゃめい}を{変更|へんこう}する — to change the company name
- {正式|せいしき}{会社名|かいしゃめい} — official company name
- {旧|きゅう}{会社名|かいしゃめい} — former company name

RELATED WORDS:
- {社名|しゃめい} — company name (shorter form, common in news and business)
- {商号|しょうごう} — trade name; business name (legal term)
- {屋号|やごう} — trade name; shop name (for sole proprietors)
